name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]

# Cancel outdated runs for efficiency
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Minimal permissions required for community/fork PRs
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: 1
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

jobs:
  # Job 1: Code Quality
  code-quality:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: |
          # Check if lockfile exists and is valid (simple syntax check for poetry/pip-tools)
          if [ -f "poetry.lock" ]; then
            poetry check --lock
          elif [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
            pip install -r requirements.txt --dry-run
          fi

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: |
          pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check .

      - name: Ruff format check
        run: |
          ruff format --check .

  # Job 2: Unit Tests (Core Logic)
  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            tests/unit/processing/ \
            tests/unit/graph/ \
            tests/unit/chunking/ \
            tests/unit/retrieval/ \
            tests/unit/search/ \
            tests/unit/pipelines/ \
            tests/unit/visualization/ \
            tests/unit/ontology/ \
            tests/unit/permissions/ \
            tests/unit/cache/ \
            tests/unit/session/ \
            tests/unit/config/ \
            tests/unit/eval/ \
            -v \
            --tb=short \
            --ignore=tests/unit/api/ \
            --ignore=tests/unit/test_rate_limiting_realistic.py \
            --ignore=tests/unit/test_embedding_rate_limiting_realistic.py

  # Job 3: CLI Unit Tests
  cli-tests:
    name: CLI Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run CLI Unit Tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/unit/cli/ -v --tb=short

  # Job 4: Telemetry Test
  telemetry-tests:
    name: Telemetry Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run Telemetry Tests
        run: |
          pytest tests/unit/telemetry/ -v --tb=short

  # Job 5: Final Status Aggregation
  community-tests-status:
    name: Community Tests Status
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - code-quality
      - unit-tests
      - cli-tests
      - telemetry-tests
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check results
        run: |
          echo "Checking results of all community test jobs..."
          
          # Check if any required job failed
          if [ "${{ needs.code-quality.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.unit-tests.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.cli-tests.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.telemetry-tests.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::One or more community test jobs failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All community tests passed successfully!"
